decisions.reason: As a close-to-core software product with a dedicated product page and strong fit to the firm's move toward connected, data-driven infrastructure management, it likely meets or is close enough to aspiration levels to justify continued support.

Because it overlaps with Product A, was only lightly presented on the website, and would tie up scarce software development attention, it is the weaker candidate and its resources are better redirected to stronger digital offerings and new search.

This safety-oriented hardware addition had clear standalone presentation, fits the firm's project business for municipal infrastructure, and can be carried with current organisational slack while market acceptance becomes clearer.

Although only mentioned on the website, it builds on the firm's established water-treatment equipment base and is useful in integrated solution selling, so a medium-sized growing firm would likely retain it for now.

Control technology for water engineering machinery is highly aligned with the firm's core capabilities and future direction, so even with limited evidence it is worth keeping as a strategically important product.
